text: Preflight JSON structure with a bounded scanner that emits a stable, phase-tagged refusal before recursion can occur.
rationale: Makes depth failures predictable and auditable instead of interpreter-dependent.

text: Convert oversized-integer failures into a documented refusal keyed to field path and digit count, never a traceback.
rationale: Makes Python’s integer-limit boundary explicit and traceable.

text: Detect unpaired surrogates before serialization and refuse atomically before any UTF-8 bytes are written.
rationale: Prevents partial output and makes Unicode failure behavior provable.

text: Constrain stderr to a fixed redacted event grammar containing input kind, phase, reason, and offset only.
rationale: Proves diagnostics cannot disclose receipt content.

text: Record each synthetic malformed fixture’s exit code, stdout byte count, and diagnostic code as acceptance evidence.
rationale: Creates reproducible proof for every refusal path.

text: Capture runtime-sensitive parser limits in a startup capability record rather than relying on ambient interpreter defaults.
rationale: Makes deployment-dependent boundaries inspectable and compliant.
